known_gaps: Annotation is 0 of 0. does_well and does_badly are judgements and stay null until a person writes them.
Nothing here was generated by this pipeline. Every row is a real output a person obtained from a named tool on a named date.
This dataset goes out of date faster than any other in the corpus. A row is a fact about one tool on one day, not about generators.

Colour pairs are computed from the rendered DOM, so a background painted on an ancestor is resolved by walking up. An output that paints text over an image will report the image element’s colour and be wrong; those rows need a person.
